criterion_bindings.exemption: Grant validation is a transport-layer property below scenario grain. The guarantee is proved by TestGrantJSONSignatureRoundTripAndFailuresAtCommandBoundary (cmd/concord/main_test.go) and TestGrantBootstrapAndInvocationBinding (internal/agent/authority_test.go).

Secret non-exposure is a transport invariant. The guarantee is proved by TestInvokeNeverEchoesGrantToken (cmd/concord/main_test.go) and TestGrantRefusalsCarryTheUnauthorizedKind (internal/agent/authority_refusal_kind_test.go).

Single-envelope stdout is a transport property. The guarantee is proved by TestDecodeInvokeRequestRejectsInvalidTrailingJSON (internal/agent/runtime_test.go) and the adapter contract tests (adapter/opencode/generated-contract-tests.ts).
Same-key retry is a dispatch property. The guarantee is proved by TestDispatchIdempotentReplaySurvivesAmbientScopeDrift (internal/agent/mutation_dispatch_test.go).

The approval bridge is a host-adapter property. The guarantee is proved by TestDispatchApprovalChallengeRoundTripIsDurableAndSingleUse and TestDispatchFailedDomainEffectRollsBackGrantAndApproval (internal/agent/mutation_dispatch_test.go).

summary: Binds the OpenCode adapter to one module that registers generated tools and spawns the short-lived Go binary.
